name: Wreckage of the Silver Dawning
summary: The Wreckage of the Silver Dawning marks the submerged remains of an Alliance frigate resting off the northern coastline of Darkshore. Sunk by aggressive coastal murlocs while approaching port at Auberdine, its drowned hull serves as a grim testament to the hazards plaguing local shipping.

sections.title: A Perilous Voyage Cut Short
sections.body: Having successfully braved the perils of the Great Sea, the crew of the frigate Silver Dawning came within sight of their destination at Auberdine before tragedy struck. Rather than reef or storm, the vessel was ambushed by coastal murlocs lurking in the northern waters of Darkshore. Overwhelmed just south of the Mist Veil, the ship took on water and sank into the shallow sea floor. While some crew members managed to swim to the safety of the shore, their captain tragically went down with the ship, leaving its sunken cargo and belongings scattered in the tide.

faq.answer: The Silver Dawning was an Alliance frigate that journeyed across the Great Sea toward Kalimdor. It was ambushed and sunk just offshore from Auberdine in northern Darkshore.
The vessel was attacked by local murlocs as it made its final approach to port. The sea creatures overwhelmed the frigate, causing it to founder and sink into the shallows.
Yes, several members of the crew managed to escape into the water and swim safely to the Darkshore coast. However, the vessel's captain remained behind and drowned with the ship.
The sunken hull lies submerged in the waters off the northern coast of Darkshore, situated just south of the Mist Veil and north of Auberdine.

angles.text: The loss of the Silver Dawning highlights how fragile the maritime supply and travel routes have become along the coast of Kalimdor, even within sight of friendly harbors like Auberdine.
